description:
Update an inline comment. This can be used to update the body text of a comment and/or to resolve the comment

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the content of the page or blogpost and its corresponding space. Permission to create comments in the space.

parameters.name: comment-id
parameters.description: The ID of the comment to be retrieved.

requestBody.description: The inline comment to be updated

200.description: Returned if the inline comment is updated successfully.

base.description: Base url of the Confluence site.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if:
- The comment was not found
- The calling user does not have permission to view the comment
- The user is forbidden from updating a comment tied to a resource they are allowed to view
